items.question: How do I add custom fields to the employee profile?
items.answer: Go to **Policy > Custom Field Setup**, click **Add**, and configure the field name, type (text, dropdown, date, etc.), and which section it belongs to. Custom fields will automatically appear in the employee profile form.

items.question: What is the maximum file size for employee document uploads?
items.answer: Images can be up to **500 KB** and documents (PDF, Word, Excel) up to **5 MB** each. You can upload up to **10 files** per record.

items.question: How does the employee ID auto-generation work?
items.answer: Employee IDs follow the pattern `EMP` + 6-digit running number (e.g., EMP000001). The running number is configured in **Policy > Running Nos**. You can customize the prefix and starting number per company.

items.question: Can I bulk import employees from Excel?
items.answer: Yes. Go to **Employee > Employee Book**, click the **Import** button, download the template Excel file, fill in the data, and upload. The system will validate and create employee records. Duplicate employee IDs will be flagged as errors.
